summary_cn: 泰国知识产权部门加强打击盗版电影和电视剧，呼吁公众远离非法平台。盗版内容跨平台扩散容易导致用户金钱损失和个人数据泄露。相关法律规定供应盗版内容者需承担法律责任。

title: Somchart to get final summons
desc: The Department of Special Investigation (DSI) will issue a final summons on Monday to Somchart Techathavorncharoen, a Phuket MP from the People's Party, to testify as a witness in an inquiry into property ownership and the alleged use of Thai nominees for foreign nationals, the Justice Ministry said.
title_cn: 普吉岛议员索姆察获最终传唤令
summary_cn: 特别调查部门将于周一向普吉岛人民党议员索姆察·德差塔沃查查(Somchart Techathavorncharoen)发出最终传唤令，要求其就财产所有权以及涉嫌利用泰籍代理人为外国人谋利等事项作证。这是该案调查的关键进展。
desc_original: The Department of Special Investigation (DSI) will issue a final summons on Monday to Somchart Techathavorncharoen, a Phuket MP from the People's Party, to testify as a witness in an inquiry into property ownership and the alleged use of Thai nominees for foreign nationals, the Justice Ministry said.

summary_cn: 奥伊西（Oishi）饮料公司推出新口味绿茶「草莓之吻」，定价10泰铢，目标消费人群为年轻人和上班族。公司在泰国北部和东北地区展开密集营销，包括当地媒体宣传、体验活动和抽奖促销，致力于扩大地方市场的消费者基础。

title: Cabinet mulls extending co-pay scheme
desc: The cabinet is set to consider extending the "Thai Chuay Thai Plus" co-payment scheme on Tuesday. Local wholesalers and retailers are backing the extension.
title_cn: 泰国内阁拟延长「泰国助泰」共付计划
summary_cn: 泰国内阁定于周二审议是否延长「泰国助泰升级版」（Thai Chuay Thai Plus）共付计划。该计划通过政府补贴帮助消费者分摊购物成本，已获得当地批发商和零售商的广泛支持。此举旨在进一步刺激国内消费，缓解消费者购物压力。
desc_original: The cabinet is set to consider extending the "Thai Chuay Thai Plus" co-payment scheme on Tuesday. Local wholesalers and retailers are backing the extension.

title: เอ็มบีเค ชู “Cave Fantasy” ดึงครอบครัวเปิดโลก 3D Immersiveจัดแพ็กเกจพิเศษ 1,399 บาท
desc: เอ็ม บี เค เซ็นเตอร์ ชวนครอบครัวเปิดโลก 3D Immersive ที่ Cave Fantasy จัด Family Package 1,399 บาท จากปกติ 1,647 บาท พร้อม Fantasy Space และ Fight Theater 4 มิติ ตลอดเดือน ก.ย.
title_cn: MBK中心推「洞穴幻想」3D沉浸式体验 家庭套票1399泰铢
summary_cn: MBK购物中心（MBK Center）推出「洞穴幻想」3D沉浸式体验馆，吸引家庭游客体验虚拟现实世界。家庭套票定价1399泰铢（较原价1647泰铢的折扣优惠），套票包含幻想空间和四维搏击影院等多个互动项目。该优惠活动贯穿整个九月，为曼谷家庭游客提供寓教于乐的室内娱乐新选择。

title: Postal law set for enactment by year-end
desc: The new postal law is expected to be enacted by the end of this year to address regulatory gaps and distortions in the rapidly expanding delivery and logistics market, according to Thailand Post president Dhanant Subhadrabandhu.
title_cn: 泰国新邮政法有望年底前颁布
summary_cn: 泰国邮政公司（Thailand Post）总裁达南特（Dhanant Subhadrabandhu）日前宣布，新邮政法拟在年底前正式颁布实施。该法规旨在填补现有监管空白，并纠正快速扩张的物流配送市场中的市场扭曲现象。完善的法律框架将进一步规范泰国邮政与快递行业的健康发展。
desc_original: The new postal law is expected to be enacted by the end of this year to address regulatory gaps and distortions in the rapidly expanding delivery and logistics market, according to Thailand Post president Dhanant Subhadrabandhu.

title: Larger data centres set to shift beyond Bangkok
desc: Bangkok remains Thailand's main data centre hub, but infrastructure constraints and tighter regulatory requirements could push larger projects outside the capital, according to Kasikorn Research Center.
title_cn: 大型数据中心逐步转向曼谷以外地区
summary_cn: 根据卡西空研究中心（Kasikorn Research Center）的分析，虽然曼谷目前仍为泰国主要数据中心枢纽，但基础设施约束和日益严格的监管要求可能促使大型数据中心项目逐步迁出首都。这一趋势将推动泰国数据中心产业的地域均衡分布，为地方经济发展创造新机遇。
desc_original: Bangkok remains Thailand's main data centre hub, but infrastructure constraints and tighter regulatory requirements could push larger projects outside the capital, according to Kasikorn Research Center.

title: Households face rising health costs
desc: Households are likely to bear a larger share of healthcare costs in the future, as the government will have less capacity to shoulder the burden, according to Kiatnakin Phatra Financial Group (KKP).
title_cn: 家庭医疗成本面临上升压力
summary_cn: 根据泰国财务集团 Kiatnakin Phatra Financial Group（KKP）的分析，随着政府财政压力增大，家庭未来将需要承担更多的医疗成本。该机构指出，政府公共医疗预算面临严峻压力，难以继续提供现有水平的补助。这意味着医疗成本增加将直接影响泰国家庭特别是中低收入群体的生活开支。
desc_original: Households are likely to bear a larger share of healthcare costs in the future, as the government will have less capacity to shoulder the burden, according to Kiatnakin Phatra Financial Group (KKP).

title: Saudi attack dents Mideast market
desc: The recent attack near Riyadh Airport could further hamper Saudi Arabia and the Middle East market, which have not fully recovered from the Gulf conflict that erupted earlier this year, according to the Association of Thai Travel Agents (Atta).
title_cn: 沙特遇袭事件打击中东旅游市场
summary_cn: 泰国旅游代理商协会（Atta）表示，利雅得（Riyadh）机场附近的遇袭事件将进一步打击沙特阿拉伯和中东市场的恢复前景。该地区目前尚未从今年早些时候爆发的海湾冲突中完全恢复，新的安全威胁将加重市场不确定性。对于依赖中东市场的泰国旅游业而言，这一事件的负面影响不容忽视。
desc_original: The recent attack near Riyadh Airport could further hamper Saudi Arabia and the Middle East market, which have not fully recovered from the Gulf conflict that erupted earlier this year, according to the Association of Thai Travel Agents (Atta).

title: Policymakers urged to back alcohol-to-jet technology
desc: Business leaders and energy industry representatives are calling on policymakers to accelerate support for alcohol-to-jet (ATJ) technology, saying it could help reduce its reliance on imported crude oil while creating new demand for domestic agricultural products.
title_cn: 推动酒精制喷气燃料技术成为战略焦点
summary_cn: 泰国商业领袖和能源行业代表呼吁政策制定者加快推进酒精制喷气燃料（Alcohol-to-Jet, ATJ）技术的发展。这一新技术不仅有助于减少泰国对进口原油的依赖、降低能源成本，还能为国内农产品创造新的市场需求，实现能源和农业的协同发展。该举措对于泰国实现经济可持续转型具有重要的战略意义。
desc_original: Business leaders and energy industry representatives are calling on policymakers to accelerate support for alcohol-to-jet (ATJ) technology, saying it could help reduce its reliance on imported crude oil while creating new demand for domestic agricultural products.

title: AirAsia worries markets despite reassurances
desc: Analysts are expressing concern over Asia Aviation (AAV), saying higher jet fuel prices and financial strains faced by its Malaysian parent, AirAsia, could eventually affect the SET-listed low-cost carrier's operations.
title_cn: 亚洲航空股价面临多重压力
summary_cn: 市场分析人士对泰国上市航空公司亚洲航空（Asia Aviation, AAV）的前景表示担忧。国际航空燃油价格高企，加上其马来西亚母公司亚洲航空集团（AirAsia）面临的财务困难，这些负面因素最终可能波及泰国上市子公司的日常运营和财务表现。在全球航空业竞争激烈的环境中，这一系列压力值得投资者和市场关注。
desc_original: Analysts are expressing concern over Asia Aviation (AAV), saying higher jet fuel prices and financial strains faced by its Malaysian parent, AirAsia, could eventually affect the SET-listed low-cost carrier's operations.

title: Business groups urged to help bolster investment
desc: Finance Minister Ekniti Nitithanprapas has urged business groups to help drive investment in seven strategic industries as Thailand seeks to become a high-income economy within the next four years.
title_cn: 财政部长敦促商界投资七大战略产业
summary_cn: 泰国财政部长 Ekniti Nitithanprapas 呼吁商业集团积极参与投资七个战略产业，以推动泰国经济向高收入国家行列迈进，目标在未来四年内完成。这七个战略产业是泰国经济增长和产业升级的关键领域。政府通过激励商业投资，旨在实现更快速和更可持续的经济发展，反映了泰国在经济政策上的新方向。
desc_original: Finance Minister Ekniti Nitithanprapas has urged business groups to help drive investment in seven strategic industries as Thailand seeks to become a high-income economy within the next four years.

title: Stock exchange vows to continue its package of major reforms
desc: The Stock Exchange of Thailand (SET) is pursuing a sweeping package of statutory and structural reforms to strengthen corporate governance, attract high-growth new economy listings and make Thai companies more attractive to investors, says SET chairman Kitipong Urapeepatanapong.
title_cn: 泰国证券交易所承诺继续推进重大改革方案
summary_cn: 泰国证券交易所(SET)主席基提蓬·乌拉佩帕塔那蓬表示，交易所正在推进包括法定和结构性改革在内的全面改革计划，旨在加强公司治理、吸引高增长新经济上市公司，并提升泰国企业在国际投资者中的吸引力。这一系列改革措施体现了交易所推动泰国资本市场健康发展的决心。
desc_original: The Stock Exchange of Thailand (SET) is pursuing a sweeping package of statutory and structural reforms to strengthen corporate governance, attract high-growth new economy listings and make Thai companies more attractive to investors, says SET chairman Kitipong Urapeepatanapong.

title: Fuel tax cut mulled amid energy crisis
desc: The government is considering a reduction in the excise tax on fuel to ease the cost-of-living burden on the public caused by the energy crisis.
title_cn: 政府考虑削减燃油税应对能源危机
summary_cn: 在能源危机导致生活成本上升的背景下，泰国政府正在考虑降低燃油消费税，以缓解民众和企业的经济负担。燃油税削减将直接降低运输、物流成本，有助于减轻普通家庭的生活压力。这一政策调整是政府应对能源危机、稳定物价的重要举措。
desc_original: The government is considering a reduction in the excise tax on fuel to ease the cost-of-living burden on the public caused by the energy crisis.

title: PP to submit Senate vote collusion 'evidence'
desc: People's Party (PP) leader Natthaphong Ruengpanyawut said on Monday the party would submit evidence to the National Anti-Corruption Commission (NACC) by Friday over alleged collusion in the 2024 Senate election.
title_cn: 人民党向反腐委提交参议院选举串通「证据」
summary_cn: 人民党(PP)领导人纳塔蓬·瑞英帕尼亚武特周一宣布，该党将在本周五前向国家反腐委员会(NACC)提交证据，控告2024年参议院选举中存在串通舞弊行为。这起案件涉及泰国选举制度的公正性和民主进程，引起社会各界高度关注，将对泰国政治生态产生重要影响。
desc_original: People's Party (PP) leader Natthaphong Ruengpanyawut said on Monday the party would submit evidence to the National Anti-Corruption Commission (NACC) by Friday over alleged collusion in the 2024 Senate election.

title: DSI to forward Forex-3D scam dossier to prosecutors
desc: The Department of Special Investigation (DSI) is expected to forward its completed case file in the high-profile Forex-3D investment fraud investigation to public prosecutors this week.
title_cn: 特别调查局将Forex-3D诈骗案转交检控机构
summary_cn: 泰国特别调查局(DSI)预计本周将完成Forex-3D投资诈骗案的调查，并向公诉机构提交完整案卷。该案是近年来备受瞩目的重大诈骗案件，涉及大规模非法集资和投资欺诈，受害者众多。案卷提交后，公诉机构将决定是否正式起诉相关嫌疑人。
desc_original: The Department of Special Investigation (DSI) is expected to forward its completed case file in the high-profile Forex-3D investment fraud investigation to public prosecutors this week.

title: Senators query EC after names appear in probe files
desc: A group of senators calling themselves New Breed senators have questioned the Election Commission (EC) over complaints against them after finding their names in separate investigation files.
title_cn: 参议员名单现身调查文件 质询选委会
summary_cn: 自称「新一代参议员」的一群参议员在发现自己的名字出现在独立调查文件中后，向选举委员会(EC)提出质询。这些参议员要求委员会解释针对他们的投诉内容并说明调查进展，反映了围绕参议院合规性和选举程序的持续政治争议，体现了参议院内部的权力制衡。
desc_original: A group of senators calling themselves New Breed senators have questioned the Election Commission (EC) over complaints against them after finding their names in separate investigation files.

title: Air hostess heroin case advances
desc: The Office of the Attorney-General (OAG) has ordered the indictment of four suspects allegedly linked to a transnational drug trafficking network involving Thai Airways flight attendant Meena Kondo in a heroin smuggling case.
title_cn: 泰航空姐毒品案进展，律政署下令起诉四名嫌疑人
summary_cn: 泰国律政署下令起诉四名嫌疑人，他们涉嫌参与一个跨国毒品贩运网络。案件涉及泰国航空公司空姐Meena Kondo走私海洛因。此案反映了国际毒品走私网络的活跃，可能对机场安全和国际旅客造成影响。
desc_original: The Office of the Attorney-General (OAG) has ordered the indictment of four suspects allegedly linked to a transnational drug trafficking network involving Thai Airways flight attendant Meena Kondo in a heroin smuggling case.

title: PM eyes stronger Japan ties
desc: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul on Monday urged Thailand and Japan to move from producing goods for one another to producing them together, saying closer supply-chain ties would help sustain Japanese investment as the automotive industry shifts towards electric vehicles.
title_cn: 泰国总理促深化泰日经济合作，共同应对电动车转型
summary_cn: 泰国总理阿努廷周一呼吁泰日两国从各自生产转向联合制造，认为深化供应链合作能维持日本在电动汽车时代的投资。这一举措旨在强化两国经贸关系，应对全球汽车产业转型。
desc_original: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul on Monday urged Thailand and Japan to move from producing goods for one another to producing them together, saying closer supply-chain ties would help sustain Japanese investment as the automotive industry shifts towards electric vehicles.

title: Seniors urged to use traditional Chinese medicine  to slow cognitive decline
desc: Older people are being encouraged to adopt four daily practices based on traditional Chinese medicine to help maintain brain health and slow cognitive decline.
title_cn: 老年人宜采用中医疗法缓解认知功能衰退
summary_cn: 卫生部门鼓励老年人采用四项基于中医理论的日常保健方法，以维持脑部健康、缓减认知衰退。这些传统养生实践被认为有助于改善老年人的脑健康。
desc_original: Older people are being encouraged to adopt four daily practices based on traditional Chinese medicine to help maintain brain health and slow cognitive decline.

title: Govt racing to conclude US tariff negotiations
desc: Thailand is seeking to conclude trade negotiations with the United States before Washington announces the results of investigations into Thai trade practices that could lead to additional tariffs, Deputy Prime Minister and Commerce Minister Suphajee Suthumpun said.
title_cn: 泰国加紧美国关税谈判，力争在调查公布前达成协议
summary_cn: 泰国商业副总理兼商务部长素帕杰表示，泰国正力争在美国宣布对泰国贸易行为调查结果前达成贸易协议，以避免面临额外关税。这反映了美泰贸易谈判的紧迫性和复杂性。
desc_original: Thailand is seeking to conclude trade negotiations with the United States before Washington announces the results of investigations into Thai trade practices that could lead to additional tariffs, Deputy Prime Minister and Commerce Minister Suphajee Suthumpun said.

title: Anutin says cabinet has no ties to grey businesses
desc: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul insisted on Monday that no member of his cabinet has ties to grey or illicit businesses and that his government has no reason to compromise with anyone involved in illegal activities.
title_cn: 总理阿努廷否认内阁与灰色产业有关联
summary_cn: 总理阿努廷周一强调，其内阁成员与灰色或非法业务没有任何关联，政府无需与涉及非法活动的人士妥协。此言论旨在回应对政府廉洁性的质疑。
desc_original: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul insisted on Monday that no member of his cabinet has ties to grey or illicit businesses and that his government has no reason to compromise with anyone involved in illegal activities.

title: Farmers oppose seed changes
desc: Farmer groups and their civil society allies will gather at the Agriculture Ministry on Wednesday to oppose draft legal changes that would align Thailand with an international convention granting plant breeders stronger intellectual property rights over new seed varieties.
title_cn: 农民反对种子改革法案
summary_cn: 泰国农民团体及民间组织将于周三在农业部集会，反对政府拟议的法律改革草案。该草案旨在使泰国与国际公约接轨，强化植物育种者对新品种种子的知识产权保护。农民担忧此举将提高种子采购成本，限制农民的育种自主权。
desc_original: Farmer groups and their civil society allies will gather at the Agriculture Ministry on Wednesday to oppose draft legal changes that would align Thailand with an international convention granting plant breeders stronger intellectual property rights over new seed varieties.

title: Thailand tourist arrivals top 22m as Malaysia, Japan surge
desc: Thailand tourist arrivals top 22m as Malaysia, Japan surge Legacy Thailand tourist arrivals have passed 22.18 million so far this year, while the latest weekly figures improved as holiday travel from Malaysia and Japan gave short-haul markets a lift ahead of the October high season. Tourism and Sports Minister Surasak Phancharoenworakul said yesterday, September 21, that Thailand welcomed 22,183,678 foreign visitors between January 1 and September 19. The total was still 3.67% lower than during the same period last yea r, while foreign tourism revenue reached 1.082821 trillion baht. China remained Thailand’s largest source market with 3,728,585 visitors, followed by Malaysia with 2,831,654 and India with 1,640,441. Russia ranked fourth with 1,230,256 arrivals, while South Korea contributed 811,246. The latest week showed a stronger picture as Thailand recorded 464,200 foreign arrivals from September 13 to 19, an increase of 25,131 visitors, or 5.72%, from the previous week. That worked out to an average of 66,314 arrivals per day. Short-haul markets accounted for 324,816 visitors, rising 8.59% week on week, while long-haul arrivals slipped 0.41% to 139,384. title: Thai King’s son wants to return to Thailand for urgent brain surgery
desc: Thai King’s son wants to return to Thailand for urgent brain surgery Legacy Dr Chakriwat “Than Aong” Vivacharawongse, a son of Thailand’s King Maha Vajiralongkorn, has spoken publicly about his wish to return to Thailand for urgent brain surgery. In a video posted overnight, Dr Chakriwat said he has two large brain tumours requiring surgery. He wants to receive treatment in Thailand because he believes Thai doctors have the necessary expertise. He said he does not have enough money to undergo the operation in Malaysia or the United States. He also fears he could die if he does not receive proper treatment in time. “I want to return to Thailand for treatment because Thai doctors are highly capable,” he said in the video, according to his account of the situation. The appeal provides new details about the medical emergency he disclosed on September 18. At the time, the 43-year-old physician said his health was in a “truly terrible condition” and that several neurologists had warned he could become bedridden or lose his life if treatment were delayed. title: Doping shock rocks Thailand camp at Asian Games
desc: Badminton player Pitchamon Opatniputh has emerged as the first known doping case at the 20th Asian Games in Japan, after the 19-year-old rising star returned a positive test that has rocked Thailand's campaign in Aichi-Nagoya.
title_cn: 亚运会兴奋剂丑闻 泰国羽毛球新星检测阳性
summary_cn: 在日本爱知-名古屋举办的第20届亚运会上，19岁泰国羽毛球新星皮查蒙·奥帕特尼普塔（Pitchamon Opatniputh）药检呈阳性，成为本届亚运会首例兴奋剂违规案例，对泰国体育代表团造成重大打击。
desc_original: Badminton player Pitchamon Opatniputh has emerged as the first known doping case at the 20th Asian Games in Japan, after the 19-year-old rising star returned a positive test that has rocked Thailand's campaign in Aichi-Nagoya.

title_cn: 长寿不只属于人类 泰国宠物医疗支出年增15%
summary_cn: 根据泰国KTC信用卡公司数据分析，宠物医疗支出呈上升趋势，同比增长15%，其中私营宠物医院增速最快。这一增长反映出宠物主人对全方位健康护理的重视，诊疗范围从传统治疗扩展至个性化护理方案，显示泰国消费者对宠物健康投资的增加。

summary_cn: 新晋富豪面临「暴富综合征」困境，资产增长过快导致生活难以适应。这是普通人难以理解的心理和社会适应挑战——突然拥有大量财富却在生活方式、人际关系和身份认同上遭遇困扰。专家建议采取积极措施如寻求财务咨询、心理辅导等化解这一现象。

title_cn: LINE MAN 推 AI 助小商户 采用技术商家存活率升至93%
summary_cn: LINE MAN Wongnai 推出 AI 工具 Wongnai Genie 和 POS 系统支持泰国小商户。数据显示使用该技术平台的商家存活率大幅提升至93%。通过与金融机构和政府扶持项目合作，该平台致力于帮助中小企业降低成本、提升竞争力，推动 SME 实现可持续增长。
desc_original: LINE MAN Wongnai ดันร้านเล็กสู้ศึกเศรษฐกิจ นำ AI “Wongnai Genie” และระบบ POS ช่วยเพิ่มอัตราอยู่รอด 93% พร้อมหนุนสินเชื่อและโครงการรัฐ พลิกฟื้น SMEs โตยั่งยืน

title: City Hall working on new master drainage plan for Bangkok
desc: Bangkok's City Hall has partnered with a Japanese government agency in designing a long-term urban drainage master plan to prepare the capital for heavier rainfall, with a target of coping with 100 millimetres of rain per hour.
title_cn: 曼谷市政厅推进排水系统总体规划 应对极端降雨
summary_cn: 曼谷市政厅与日本政府机构合作制定长期城市排水总体规划，为应对日益加剧的极端降雨做准备。规划目标是提高城市排水能力至每小时100毫米降雨量。这是曼谷适应气候变化、提升城市韧性的重要基础设施投资。
desc_original: Bangkok's City Hall has partnered with a Japanese government agency in designing a long-term urban drainage master plan to prepare the capital for heavier rainfall, with a target of coping with 100 millimetres of rain per hour.

title: Chon Buri flags 14,264 firms with foreign shareholders for nominee checks
desc: Chon Buri flags 14,264 firms with foreign shareholders for nominee checks Legacy Seventy companies were picked for detailed checks and 39 were rated high risk. Sixteen gave no explanation, and all the cases are now with the Department of Special Investigation. Chon Buri has identified 14,264 companies with foreign shareholders or co-investors as needing risk monitoring. Officials say the review is looking for firms that use Thai nominees or hold land illegally. The figures were presented to a House foreign affairs committee at Pattaya City Hall on Friday, September 18. Officials stressed that foreign shareholding was not in itself illegal. The provincial commerce chief, Hathairat Keerival, said 70 companies were selected for detailed inspection in the first phase. Fifty-four submitted explanations and 16 did not. A risk assessment put 39 of the 70 in the high-risk group and 31 in the low-risk group. All the cases are now under investigation by the DSI, Hathairat said. In Banglamung district alone, 350 companies with foreign ownership hold land. That figure came from Chaiporn Prasertsiri of the Banglamung branch of the Chon Buri Land Office. title: 3 Thai women held at Sri Lanka airport with nearly 8kg of cannabis
desc: 3 Thai women held at Sri Lanka airport with nearly 8kg of cannabis Legacy Three Thai women were arrested at Bandaranaike International Airport in Katunayake, Sri Lanka , after almost eight kilogrammes of cannabis were found hidden in their luggage. The Airport Police Narcotics Bureau announced the arrests on Sunday, September 20. According to Sri Lankan authorities, the three women had travelled from Bangkok on the same Thai Airways flight, TG307, which landed at about 12.50am. Police reportedly found the drugs hidden inside their luggage, with the packages disguised as nutritional supplements, collagen products and bars of soap. The arrests were made during two separate operations. In the first operation, a 38 year old Thai woman was allegedly found carrying 3.22 kilogrammes of cannabis and 1.85 kilogrammes of hashish. Photo by Nednapa via Getty Images In the second operation, a 31 year old Thai woman was allegedly found with 1.99 kilogrammes of Kush and 620 grammes of hashish. Another Thai woman, aged 36, who travelled on the same flight, was also arrested on suspicion of assisting with cannabis trafficking. title: Thailand weighs minimum delivery rider pay, platform pushes back
desc: Thailand weighs minimum delivery rider pay, platform pushes back Legacy Thailand is moving towards a minimum compensation framework for app-based delivery riders , with officials looking beyond an ongoing dispute involving Lalamove to develop rules that could eventually apply more broadly across digital platforms. Digital Economy and Society Minister Chaichanok Chidchob said the ministry is collecting information on rider costs and payment rates to develop a minimum-rate formula. Rather than relying only on data from Lalamove and its riders, officials plan to expand the study to other platforms and groups of workers before deciding what an appropriate benchmark should look like. The work could eventually feed into legislation covering platform workers, a group that currently does not have a specific law directly regulating compensation in this area. title_cn: 泰国经济真的衰退了吗？消费疲软导致逾万家企业倒闭
